intended_use: Certify condition-level support for the frozen binary-complement block without inspecting strategy candidates, outcomes, rates, or economics.
grain: one unique post-registration five-minute condition with terminal Gamma state and official Chainlink settlement alignment

support_accounting.admission_rate_interpretation: reference-tape and settlement data availability only; not a strategy selection or win rate

resolved_findings.finding: Ten current floor segments and one older continuation segment stopped at WAIT_FOR_TERMINAL_MARKETS and were omitted from support after Gamma became terminal.
resolved_findings.impact: 198 valid conditions were missing from the blinded support count; no strategy metric was affected or disclosed.
resolved_findings.root_cause: The original runner used only three finalization attempts over 60 seconds, and the collector refreshed only its newest base directory.
resolved_findings.remediation: Use a bounded 31-attempt/30-second finalization wait for future captures, refresh terminal-only pending statuses across every registered source root, and keep all non-terminal blockers fail closed.
resolved_findings.result: All 11 pending segments resolved on one refresh; support moved from 43 to 241.

resolved_findings.finding: The older continuation segment used the legacy unfiltered conversion-manifest shape: 24 converted markets for 20 audited admissible conditions and no selection metadata.
resolved_findings.impact: The modern exact-allowlist verifier correctly rejected the legacy shape, but this initially prevented terminal-only refresh of otherwise intact data.
resolved_findings.remediation: A separate legacy-only preflight now requires selection metadata to be absent, zero conversion errors, all 20 audited condition IDs present, valid replay output metadata, and group-specific terminal finalization. Modern filtered manifests retain exact-cardinality enforcement.
resolved_findings.result: The legacy segment passed with zero missing audited conditions and four extra converted conditions; only the 20 audited IDs entered the condition-group manifests.

automated_invariants: modern conversion manifests require exact selected-condition cardinality and selection metadata
legacy conversion manifests are refreshable only when every audited condition exists and all conversion error counters are zero
only capture_verified terminal-only pending statuses are eligible for refresh
refresh scans every registered source root
support counts only fully ready segments with complete group-manifest cardinality and positive distilled events
support condition IDs must remain unique and post-registration
strategy metrics remain sealed below 750 unique terminal conditions

decision.reason: The support dataset is internally reconciled, but 241 conditions remain below the frozen 750-condition disclosure floor.
decision.next_check: Repeat the same accounting audit after each recovery or at the 750-condition stop.
